toc.title: Integration, business applications, developer tools, end-user computing, web, mobile and IoT

html:
1What You Will Learn

  • Choose between Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge and AWS Step Functions
  • Place Amazon Connect and Amazon SES among business applications
  • Say what AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodePipeline and AWS X-Ray do for developers
  • Tell WorkSpaces, WorkSpaces Applications and WorkSpaces Secure Browser apart
  • Recognize AWS Amplify for web and mobile and AWS IoT Core for devices

2Integration, business applications, developer tools, end-user computing, web, mobile and IoT

Running case

Tidewater's Order Day

  • A placed order must reach fulfillment, send an email and text the warehouse, all at once
  • A support team takes calls and chats, and the shop sends order confirmation emails
  • Developers want every code change built, tested and released automatically
  • Warehouse staff need a Windows application on any device, and fridge sensors must report temperatures
  • Your job: choose the service for each of these needs

Queues and Topics: Amazon SQS and Amazon SNS

  • Amazon SQS (Simple Queue Service) is a hosted queue that decouples components: producers send messages, and consumers process them later
  • Standard queues deliver at least once; FIFO queues process exactly once; messages are kept 4 days by default, up to 14
  • Amazon SNS (Simple Notification Service) is publish and subscribe: one message to a topic reaches every subscriber
  • Subscribers include SQS, Lambda, HTTP(S), email, mobile push and SMS
  • Fanout sends one SNS message to several SQS queues for parallel work

Exam tip: One message to many subscribers: SNS. Messages waiting for a consumer: SQS.

Events and Workflows: Amazon EventBridge and AWS Step Functions

Service What it does Think
Amazon EventBridge A serverless event bus that connects components with events from AWS services, your apps and SaaS partners; rules route events to targets; Pipes link one source to one target; Scheduler runs tasks on a schedule React to events
AWS Step Functions Serverless workflows (state machines) that orchestrate Lambda and other services; visual to build and debug; retry and catch errors; Standard runs up to a year, Express up to five minutes Coordinate steps

Exam tip: Route events and schedule tasks: EventBridge. Coordinate a multi-step process: Step Functions.

Business Applications: Amazon Connect and Amazon SES Old name

  • Amazon Connect is a cloud contact center: customers reach agents by voice, chat or SMS, with intelligent routing and real-time metrics
  • AWS now calls the product Amazon Connect Customer; Amazon Connect names a wider set of agentic AI solutions
  • You pay only for what you use, with no contact center hardware to run
  • Amazon SES (Simple Email Service) sends and receives email with your own addresses and domains
  • Use it for transactional email such as order confirmations, marketing email and newsletters
  • You pay by volume sent and received

Exam tip: A cloud contact center: Amazon Connect. Sending application email: Amazon SES.

Developer Tools: CodeBuild, CodePipeline and X-Ray

  • AWS CodeBuild is a fully managed build service: it compiles code, runs unit tests and produces deployable artifacts, with no build servers and billing by build minutes
  • AWS CodePipeline is continuous delivery: it models, visualizes and automates the steps that release your software
  • CodeBuild can be a build or test action inside a pipeline
  • AWS X-Ray collects data about requests, and its trace map shows bottlenecks, latency spikes and errors across services

Exam tip: Build and test: CodeBuild. Automate releases: CodePipeline. Trace and troubleshoot: X-Ray.

End-User Computing: WorkSpaces, WorkSpaces Applications and Secure Browser Old name [Verify live]

Service What it does Think
Amazon WorkSpaces Virtual, cloud-based desktops (Windows or Linux); Personal is persistent, Pools are non-persistent; reachable from many devices A whole desktop
Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (earlier AppStream 2.0) Streams desktop applications from AWS to a client or browser; data is never stored on the device One application
Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser (earlier WorkSpaces Web) Secure browser for internal websites and SaaS apps in an isolated environment; no data on the device, no VPN A safe browser
  • As of 4 November 2026: AWS closed Secure Browser to new customers on 29 October 2026; the exam guide still lists it

Exam tip: A desktop: WorkSpaces. One streamed application: WorkSpaces Applications. A secure browser: Secure Browser.

Web, Mobile and Devices: AWS Amplify and AWS IoT Core

  • AWS Amplify gives frontend web and mobile developers tools to build and host applications on AWS
  • Amplify Hosting offers a Git-based workflow with continuous deployment for full-stack serverless web apps, delivered through the AWS content delivery network
  • Features include feature branches, custom domains, pull request previews and atomic deployments
  • AWS IoT Core connects IoT devices to AWS services and to each other
  • Its message broker supports MQTT and HTTPS, and AWS IoT Core for LoRaWAN manages low-power wide-area devices

Exam tip: Frontend and mobile apps: Amplify. Connecting and managing devices: IoT Core.

What the Exam Asks: Other Services

  • SQS or SNS: messages wait in a queue, or one message goes to many subscribers
  • EventBridge or Step Functions: route events and schedules, or coordinate a workflow
  • Connect or SES: a cloud contact center, or application email
  • CodeBuild, CodePipeline or X-Ray: build and test, automate releases, or trace requests
  • WorkSpaces, WorkSpaces Applications or Secure Browser: a desktop, one application, or a safe browser
  • Amplify or IoT Core: web and mobile apps, or devices
  • AWS Support: the support plans you can add (Module 14)

Exam tip: Name the need, then the service.

Design Check: Tidewater's Order Day

Tidewater's need Choose
One order message to fulfillment, email and SMS Amazon SNS, with SQS queues
Orders wait safely until servers can process them Amazon SQS
A multi-step refund process with retries AWS Step Functions
A support team taking calls and chats Amazon Connect
Order confirmation emails Amazon SES
Every code change built, tested and released CodeBuild and CodePipeline
Find the slow call inside the shop AWS X-Ray
A Windows application on any device WorkSpaces Applications
A new storefront web app, hosted with continuous deployment AWS Amplify
Fridge sensors reporting temperatures AWS IoT Core
  • Cover the right column, answer each row yourself, then compare

3Exam Q&A

3.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer; some ask for two)

S1When Tidewater's shop takes an order, the same message must reach fulfillment and also trigger an email and a text message to the warehouse. Which service sends one message to many subscribers?

  • AAmazon SQS, which holds messages in a queue for a consumer
  • BAmazon SNS, which sends a message from a topic to many subscribers
  • CAWS Step Functions, which coordinates the steps of a workflow
  • DAWS X-Ray, which traces requests through an application
Show the answer

Answer: B. Amazon SNS publishes a message to a topic, and every subscriber, such as a queue, an email address or a phone number, receives a copy. SQS holds messages for a consumer, Step Functions coordinates workflow steps, and X-Ray traces requests.

S2The shop's web servers sometimes send order messages faster than the processing servers can handle them. Which service lets the orders wait safely until a consumer processes them?

  • AAmazon SNS, which pushes each message to its subscribers
  • BAmazon SES, which sends email from an application
  • CAmazon SQS, which stores messages in a queue until processed
  • DAWS IoT Core, which connects devices to the cloud
Show the answer

Answer: C. SQS is a hosted queue that decouples components, so messages wait until a consumer processes them. SNS pushes messages to subscribers, SES sends email, and IoT Core connects devices.

S3Tidewater's developers want every code change built, tested and released through automated stages. Which TWO services help? (Select TWO.)

  • AAWS CodeBuild, which compiles code and runs unit tests
  • BAWS CodePipeline, which automates the release steps
  • CAmazon WorkSpaces, which provides virtual desktops
  • DAWS X-Ray, which traces requests through an application
  • EAmazon Connect, which runs a cloud contact center
Show the answer

Answer: A, B. CodeBuild compiles code, runs tests and produces artifacts, and CodePipeline automates the stages that release them. WorkSpaces provides desktops, X-Ray traces requests in a running application, and Connect is a contact center.

S4Tidewater wants warehouse staff to stream a Windows desktop application from AWS to their devices, with no data stored on those devices. Which service fits best?

  • AAWS Amplify, which hosts web and mobile applications
  • BAmazon Connect Customer, which runs a contact center
  • CAWS IoT Core, which connects sensors to the cloud
  • DAmazon WorkSpaces Applications, formerly Amazon AppStream 2.0
Show the answer

Answer: D. WorkSpaces Applications, earlier called AppStream 2.0, streams desktop applications from AWS, and the data is never stored on the user's device. Amplify hosts web apps, Connect Customer is a contact center, and IoT Core connects devices.

4Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Messaging SQS queues messages, SNS fans one message out, EventBridge routes events, Step Functions coordinates workflows
Business applications Amazon Connect is a cloud contact center; Amazon SES sends email
Developer tools CodeBuild builds and tests, CodePipeline automates releases, X-Ray traces requests
End-user computing WorkSpaces for desktops, WorkSpaces Applications for streamed apps, Secure Browser for safe browsing
Web, mobile and devices Amplify for frontend and mobile apps, IoT Core for devices
